code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_title: 统计受控输入条件数量
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_summary: 返回设计中已定义的状态数，用于检查因素组合覆盖。
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_summary: Return the number of enumerated states in the controlled-input design.

code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_summary: 按双射映射重新分配状态位置，并沿用既有输入样本。
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_summary: Permute existing input-state masks while reusing the same samples.

code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_title: 按因素状态索引样本 ID
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_summary: 建立状态位掩码到样本身份的映射表。
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_title: Index sample identities by factor state
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_summary: Return the mapping from state bit masks to sample identifiers.

code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_title: 构建逐状态 Token 样本记录
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_summary: 逐个状态执行分词与校验，并生成包含模型 Token 位置的样本记录。
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_title: Build tokenized records for each input state
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_summary: Tokenize and validate all design states and create model-bound sample records.

code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_title: 从 Manifest 读取状态样本索引
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.zh_summary: 从存档状态字段恢复位掩码与样本编号的对应关系。
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_title: Read state identities from a manifest
code:method:datasets.controlled_inputs:C.en_summary: Map serialized state masks to the sample IDs stored in the manifest.

code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_title: 提取指定层完整序列的隐藏状态
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_summary: 捕获目标层所有 Token 的残差隐藏向量，返回三维激活张量。
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_title: Capture complete hidden states at a layer
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_summary: Return full-sequence residual activations from the selected transformer block.

code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_title: 同时采集隐藏状态和预测分数
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_summary: 在一次前向计算中返回目标层激活与每个 Token 的词表 Logit。
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_title: Capture hidden activations together with logits
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_summary: Return site activations and vocabulary logits from a single forward pass.

code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_title: 批量测量指定位置的激活与 Logit
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_summary: 按样本位置执行 Hook 前向传播，返回批量激活和读出预测分数。
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_title: Run batched activation and logit readouts
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_summary: Return per-sample Hook activations and readout logits at selected token positions.

code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_title: 在指定层注入残差补丁并计算 Logit
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.zh_summary: 用位置映射替换残差激活，再读取指定输出位置的词表分数。
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_title: Compute logits with residual activation patches
code:method:models.hf_hooks_backend:HFHo.en_summary: Apply position-specific residual patches and return logits at the requested readout.

code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.zh_title: 统计分解后的模型组件数量
code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.zh_summary: 读取组件贡献向量矩阵的首维长度，确定可分析的组件个数。
code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.en_summary: Read the leading dimension of component contribution vectors.

code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.zh_title: 汇总组件向量与残差偏置
code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.zh_summary: 将各组件贡献向量求和并加上偏置项，恢复总贡献向量。
code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.en_title: Sum component vectors with the residual bias
code:method:saebase.api.components:Compo.en_summary: Combine per-component contribution vectors and their bias into a single total.

code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.zh_title: 统计细粒度分解组件的个数
code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.zh_summary: 返回细粒度贡献向量的数量，以便组织后续组件分析。
code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.en_summary: Return the number of fine-grained component contribution vectors.

code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.zh_title: 重建细粒度分量的总体贡献
code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.zh_summary: 汇总细粒度组件向量并添加偏置，得到重建后的总投影。
code:method:saebase.api.fine_components:.en_summary: Sum fine-grained contribution vectors and their bias to obtain the combined projection.

code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_title: 从 SAE 元数据定位模型 Hook
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_summary: 使用保存的层编号和 Hook 名称构造 ActivationSite。
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_title: Resolve the activation Hook from SAE identity
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_summary: Construct an ActivationSite from the recorded layer and Hook name.

code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_title: 从加载的 SAE 校验并建立模型身份
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_summary: 核查编码维度与权重元数据，再构建 SAEIdentity 记录。
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_title: Validate identity from a loaded SAE
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_summary: Check SAE dimensions against metadata before constructing its identity record.

code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_title: 为自定义 SAE 构建身份记录
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.zh_summary: 将检查点、模型、层位置与自定义加载信息交给统一身份校验入口。
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_title: Create an identity record for a custom SAE
code:method:saebase.api.metadata:SAEIden.en_summary: Bind custom checkpoint, model, and activation-site metadata through the validated identity constructor.

code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.zh_title: 采集指定 Hook 的激活向量
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.zh_summary: 核验捕获能力与目标层位置，返回模型在所选 Token 的特征向量。
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.en_title: Capture an activation vector at a model Hook
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.en_summary: Validate the activation site and return the hidden vector at the selected token.

code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.zh_title: 一次调用同时读取激活和基线 Logit
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.zh_summary: 采集目标 Hook 向量，并读取指定位置的输出分数以供后续对照。
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.en_title: Capture activations and baseline logits together
code:method:saebase.api.model:ModelAdapt.en_summary: Return the site vector and readout logits, using a shared forward when the backend supports it.

code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.zh_title: 使用 NNsight 追踪单次输入
code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.zh_summary: 在一个 trace 上下文中保存目标组件激活并转换成 Tensor。
code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.en_title: Capture one activation trace with NNsight
code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.en_summary: Trace a single input and materialize the selected component activation as a tensor.

code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.zh_title: 按输入顺序批量执行 NNsight 追踪
code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.zh_summary: 在统一追踪环境中逐次调用 invoker，并按提交顺序返回各项激活。
code:method:saebase.api.nnsight_local:NN.en_summary: Trace multiple inputs and return captured activations in original invocation order.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 登记具有幂等身份的研究作业
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 校验请求与所有者身份后，将作业和私有输入引用存入队列。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Validate ownership and request identity before storing a queued private-input reference.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 为执行 Worker 原子领取排队作业
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 核验 Worker 身份与租期，在事务中领取最早可执行的任务。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_title: Atomically claim the next queued research job
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Reserve the oldest queued job for a validated worker under a bounded lease.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 续约运行中作业的 Worker 租期
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 验证作业与尝试编号，并延长对应 Worker 的运行租约。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_title: Renew an active worker job lease
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Validate the current worker attempt and extend the running job lease.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 提交已完成作业的结果摘要或错误码
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 由执行 Worker 报告结果哈希或净化后的错误编号并更新作业状态。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_title: Commit a job result digest or error code
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Record a worker's result hash or sanitized failure code for the current attempt.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 回收过期租期并安排作业重试
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 扫描租期到期的运行记录，按尝试次数重新排队或标记终止。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_title: Reclaim expired leases and schedule retries
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Recover timed-out jobs and apply retry limits to their queue status.

code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_title: 按所有者权限查询研究作业状态
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.zh_summary: 核查作业编号和所有者摘要，仅返回该所有者对应的任务状态字段。
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_title: Read a job status under its owner's scope
code:method:saebase.research_lab.backend.en_summary: Return status metadata for a job owned by the requesting identity.
